author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Clintech has launched a Crowd Supply campaign for the Clintech Pico Board, an open-hardware microcontroller board based on Raspberry Pi’s RP2354B. The board retains the 51 × 21mm Raspberry Pi Pico footprint while exposing all 48 GPIOs available from the larger RP2354B package. title: Clintech Pico Board exposes all 48 RP2354B GPIOs in Pico-compatible form factor
